subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When rung 2 runs, the harness shall execute the test verb and fail the rung on any test failure; while a baseline is bound for the repo, the rung shall instead evaluate no-new-failures against it — failing on any failure absent from the baseline and recording observed baseline shrinkage.
rationale: full regression on healthy repos by default; honest binding on red-main repos; the ratchet only tightens
fit_criterion: a clean fixture passes and one seeded failing test reds rung 2 (no baseline bound); the red-main fixture (K pre-existing failures) passes with zero new failures and fails when one new failure is seeded; a baseline-shrink run records the shrink in the verdict
